name: scan-driver
body: The scan orchestrator: `apg scan` and the `project start` path. It decides full vs incremental (`rust.apg.delta.full_scan_reason`), decides which frontends to spawn (`rust.apg.should_spawn_language`), splices cached/reused fragments (`rust.apg.ingest`, `rust.apg.cache.rebase`), and seeds a branch DB by copy (`rust.apg.splice`). Owns the "start at an already-scanned commit is near-instant" behaviour and the no-unfiltered-spawn fast path.
